'''Utility belts''' were belts that most people used for missions or tasks that were challenging. Such belts were fitted to carry necessary supplies and gadgets for handy usage; such equipment was carried in pouches or fastened on hooks. Depending on their usage, such belts were fashioned from a variety of materials, including leather and plastics. A utility pouch is a small compartment typically worn in conjunction with a utility belt to hold items.

==Usage and design==
[[File:LukeSkywalkerFarmerOutfit-DatabankOriginal.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] utility belt carried his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and other equipment.]]
Members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] used leather utility belts for missions from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. They were created by the [[Jedi quartermaster]] and usually consisted of their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which was traditionally worn on the left, survival rations in the form of capsules, a [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] and/or a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]], a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] (such as an [[Imagecaster/Legends|Imagecaster]]), a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]], an [[A99 aquata breather/Legends|A99 aquata breather]], a [[Jedi beacon transceiver]], a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], lightsaber repair tools, and other specialized equipment. Other mission-specific equipment may be added, as assigned by the High Council or Jedi quartermaster. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wore a dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]] utility belt in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] leading up to his transformation into the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Vader. 

Non-Jedi utility belt equipment usually consisted of rope, a weapon such as a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in a [[Holster/Legends|holster]], and other equipment. Military utility belts, such as used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], were usually plastic- or metal-plated for greater protection of their contents; their equipment usually consisted of reserve power and gas packs for blasters, [[Ascension cable/Legends|ascension cables]] for climbing, and at least one meal of [[Food rations|energy rations]]. Also, the belt used by clone troopers could be used as a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] or a bomb, as [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]] did on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used the [[Grappling hook/Legends|fibercord grappling hook]] from a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper's]] utility belt to swing himself and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] over a chasm on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

An old [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] utility belt was offered for auction in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
